name: Mage’s Pistol
body:
Price 19,300 gp; Aura moderate transmutation; CL 8th; Weight 4 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This +2 Semi-Automatic Handgun is made of silver that never needs to be polished, often adorned with fancy engraving and dangling charms. A mage’s pistol is especially effective against creatures with spell resistance. Against such creatures, the weapon’s effective enhancement bonus increases to +3, and it deals an additional 1d6 points of damage. Whenever the wielder casts a spell that requires him to make a ranged touch attack (such as a ray) while he has the pistol in hand, he gains a bonus on his ranged attack roll equal to the pistol’s enhancement bonus against the target creature. If the spell hits, the caster also applies this bonus to the caster level check to overcome the target’s spell resistance (if any) and on the spell’s damage roll (if any).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 10,800 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells Spell Penetration, summon monster I, true strike
